title: Phase 12 Hypercare — LCH-03 synthetic drill fixture schema
description: Repository-only LCH-03 hypercare drill contract (PLAN.md section 8 LCH-03: heightened post-launch monitoring for an SRE-approved window based on traffic volume, not merely elapsed hours, with active on-call, issue cadence, and explicit rollback authority). This schema governs deterministic, bounded SYNTHETIC drill fixtures only. Every fixture declares a bounded synthetic session count, a declared threshold, and a traffic source that must be synthetic_local. The run-phase12-hypercare-drill harness computes and checks only a syntheticThresholdMet-style result: hypercareWindowAccepted is true if and only if syntheticSessionCount >= declaredThreshold AND trafficSource === "synthetic_local". It NEVER accepts production hypercare, real SLO attainment, error-budget health, real traffic, or wall-clock acceptance: hypercareStatus is restricted to NOT_RUN | PENDING, productionAcceptance is const false, sloAttainment/errorBudgetRemaining/errorBudgetHealthy are const null, incidentCadence and rollbackAuthority are const PENDING, and elapsedHoursOnly is const false (elapsed hours are recorded but never used for acceptance). Evidence is type synthetic_local with structurally empty sessionIds and endpoints (no IDs, no endpoints). No EV-* reference, UUID, ticket ID, or URL can authorize a positive claim. It does not duplicate or override config/current-state.json, which remains the authoritative source of truth (0/17 gates complete, 0/14 phases accepted, production pre-production, dataStage synthetic-only, scope browser-only).

declaredThreshold.description: Declared minimum number of synthetic sessions required to accept the synthetic hypercare window. A threshold of 0 is rejected: it would make the gate vacuous. The harness computes acceptance solely as syntheticSessionCount >= declaredThreshold.

syntheticSessionCount.description: Compact aggregate count of synthetic sessions used by the drill. Hard-bounded 0..10000; non-integer and out-of-range values are rejected. Fixtures commit 0, 50, 200, and 1000.

elapsedHours.description: Recorded elapsed window length in whole hours (informational only, bounded 0..168). NEVER used for acceptance: elapsedHoursOnly is const false, so wall-clock duration alone can never accept a window.

elapsedHoursOnly.description: Declares that acceptance is NOT based on elapsed hours alone. true is rejected: a wall-clock-only acceptance is a forbidden claim, and any fixture combining elapsedHoursOnly true with hypercareWindowAccepted true is a cross-field violation.

trafficSource.description: Traffic source. Only synthetic_local is valid; production, prod, live, and real are forbidden positive claims and are rejected.

hypercareWindowAccepted.description: Declared synthetic-drill window acceptance. The harness verifies it equals the computed result syntheticSessionCount >= declaredThreshold AND trafficSource === "synthetic_local". true with sessionCount below threshold, or with sessionCount 0, is rejected (non-vacuous gate). This is a synthetic drill result only: the real hypercare window status is hypercareStatus, which stays NOT_RUN | PENDING.

hypercareStatus.description: Real hypercare window status. The production hypercare window has not run and remains NOT_RUN or PENDING; RUNNING, ACTIVE, OPEN, COMPLETE, and ACCEPTED are forbidden positive claims.

productionAcceptance.description: Production acceptance is never claimed by a repository drill. true is rejected unconditionally.

sloAttainment.description: Real SLO attainment is not measured by a synthetic drill. Any non-null value (e.g., 99.95) is a forbidden real-SLO claim and is rejected.

errorBudgetRemaining.description: Real error-budget remaining is not measured by a synthetic drill. Any non-null value is a forbidden error-budget claim and is rejected.

errorBudgetHealthy.description: Error-budget health is not claimed by a synthetic drill. Any non-null value (true/false) is a forbidden claim and is rejected.

incidentCadence.description: Incident cadence roles and review cadence are PENDING; ACTIVE, SCHEDULED, and ESTABLISHED are forbidden positive claims. See docs/runbooks/launch-incident-cadence.md.

rollbackAuthority.description: Rollback authority during hypercare is PENDING; AUTHORIZED, APPROVED, GRANTED, and ACTIVE are forbidden positive claims.

sessionIds.description: Structurally forced empty: no session identifier exists in a repository drill. Any identifier value is a forbidden bypass vector and is rejected.

endpoints.description: Structurally forced empty: no endpoint, host, or URL exists in a repository drill. Any endpoint value is a forbidden claim and is rejected.
